definitions.explanation: A detailed proposal or arrangement for achieving something.
A service package or subscription option offered by a company.

notes:
プラン is used for both general plans/schemes and commercial service packages.

GENERAL PLANNING:
- プラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make a plan)
- プラン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧ (to work out a plan)
- ⟦バックアップ→バックアップ：04870_bakkuappu⟧プラン (backup plan)

COMMERCIAL USAGE:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧プラン (pricing plan)
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧プラン (accommodation package)
- ⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧プラン (flat-rate plan)
